x: Dalinsch, who was second in the Olympic Games and impressed us all when he visited England two years ago. Unfortunately the distances chosen for racing were far from ideal from Tommy's point of view and we have no doubt that different results would be recorded at 25 miles and over, good though Dalinsch undoubtedly is.

Familiar names to appear include Laisné (France), Schwab (Germany), Dalinsch (Latvia) and Mikaelson (Sweden). The standard appears to be very high, and we look forward to the time when international team walks are an accepted part of our programme.
The British Olympic Association report states that only seven of the fifteen starters finished and that Tommy and Dalinsch of Latvia were together only a mile from home.
